top_diagnoses.reasoning_summary: The presence of a well-circumscribed mass with a thin fibrous capsule, soft consistency, and lobules of fatty tissue interspersed with bands and nodules of firm white tissue, along with the absence of cytological atypia and necrosis, are all consistent with benign myolipoma.

The presence of a well-circumscribed mass with a thin fibrous capsule, soft consistency, and lobules of fatty tissue, along with the absence of cytological atypia and necrosis, are all consistent with lipoma.

The presence of a well-circumscribed mass with a thin fibrous capsule, soft consistency, and smooth muscle fibers, along with the absence of cytological atypia and necrosis, are all consistent with leiomyoma.
The presence of a palpable mass, abdominal pain, and abdominal distension, along with computed tomography scan showing a mass in the right iliac fossa, are all consistent with lipoleiomyoma.
The presence of abdominal pain, abdominal distension, and a mass with infiltrative margins on computed tomography scan, are all consistent with desmoid tumor.
